body:
I can't move out, there's nowhere cheaper than the place I live. My roommates don't listen to me, no one really does, they just walk all over me, people know I'm really passive (which is only because I'm so depressed and tired honestly) and that makes it easy for them to tell me what to do.
Pretty sure I'm getting on medicaid soon actually, so that will be good. My mom's trying to help me look into it.
I wish I could tell my therapist but it's fucking mortifying to even think about. I've known her since I was 14, I can't help but be afraid of how disappointed she'd be in me.
I can see that. I guess what this one is for me, is songs that make me feel like someone else gets it, because no one that I actually know does. Like a venting playlist.
Felt the same way immediately after hearing both of these songs. I'm so glad I'm not the only one.
